evidence.evidence_text: In this work, we develop GAS(P), an evaluation methodology for surfacing distribution-level group representational biases in generated text, tackling the setting where groups are unprompted (i.e., groups are not specified in the input to generative systems).
We apply this novel methodology to investigate gendered representations in occupations across state-of-the-art large language models.
